title: Public relay route parser
responsibility: Recognizes the relay’s public endpoints from exact method and validated path parts.

inputs.name: publicRoute.method
inputs.description: HTTP method compared exactly, including case.

inputs.name: publicRoute.pathname
inputs.description: URL pathname only, without query data.

outputs.name: publicRoute
outputs.description: Health route for GET /v1/health; GET host connect; GET pairing information; or POST pairing request, poll and exchange. Host and pairing identifiers must match protocol patterns, and returned paths are rebuilt from those validated parts. Everything else, including management paths, returns undefined.
